title: K-flat transport and localization for native ringed tensors
statement: Fix b, T and adj as in lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-complexes. There is a record asserting that b.native sends every NativeTensorKFlat complex to an independent-coefficient K-flat complex over b.R, and that NativeTensorKFlat complexes localize at quasi-isomorphisms onto the unbounded derived category.
